questions.calculated_value: (() => { if (!${dob}) return 0; const dob = new Date(${dob}); if (isNaN(dob)) return 0; const today = new Date(); let age = today.getFullYear() - dob.getFullYear(); const m = today.getMonth() - dob.getMonth(); if (m < 0 || (m === 0 && today.getDate() < dob.getDate())) age--; return age; })()

questions.calculated_value: (() => { const g = (${gender} || '').toLowerCase(); if (g === 'male') return 'M'; if (g === 'female') return 'F'; if (g === 'other') return 'O'; return ''; })()
